hack.root_cause: Leaked Owner Key + EIP-7702 Delegator Contract (onlyEOA Bypass)
hack.description: GANA Payment lost $3.1M in nine days of life — a leaked owner key enabled an EIP-7702 delegator contract to bypass the staking contract's onlyEOA protection via an ownership rotation chain across eight addresses, then drain the pool in iterative stake-unstake loops.
